gaussian_reduction.A: per-patch uniform full-voxel MSE; same-sized patch batch mean
gaussian_reduction.B: For each patch average conditional MSE of present FG/BG regions; then average patches.
gaussian_reduction.empty_foreground: sum_BG((q-t)^2)/n_BG; equal to A, keep the sample
gaussian_reduction.empty_background: sum_FG((q-t)^2)/n_FG; equal to A, keep the sample
gaussian_reduction.batch_policy: mean of individually normalized patch losses; do not pool FG/BG counts across batch
gaussian_reduction.precision: FP32 prediction/target error and reduction, including under existing mixed precision
gaussian_reduction.region_definition: training binary coronary GT label>0 defines loss mask only; never input to forward; no classifier target changes
gaussian_reduction.head_unchanged: same raw segmentation logits -> existing Conv3d(2,1,3) -> sigmoid
gaussian_reduction.log_semantics: Existing gaussian field now reports unweighted B; gaussian_weighted reports lambda10*B. These are new loss measures, not numerically comparable to old A logging.
gaussian_reduction.empty_denominator_safety: clamp_min(1) only avoids0 denominators; positive foreground counts are unchanged; no gradient/positive-count cap
